payments_reconcile_idx.name: payments_reconcile_idx
payments_reconcile_idx.where: status = 'PENDING' AND provider_payment_id IS NOT NULL

subscription_cancellation_audit_actor_ch.name: subscription_cancellation_audit_actor_check
subscription_cancellation_audit_actor_ch.value: ("payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."origin" = 'EXTERNAL' and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."actor_id" is null) or ("payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."origin" <> 'EXTERNAL' and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."actor_id" is not null and length("payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."actor_id") between 1 and 128)

subscription_cancellation_audit_case_che.name: subscription_cancellation_audit_case_check
subscription_cancellation_audit_case_che.value: ("payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."origin" = 'NONPAYMENT' and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."recovery_case_id" is not null and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."actor_id" = 'system:subscription-recovery') or ("payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."origin" <> 'NONPAYMENT' and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."recovery_case_id" is null)

subscription_cancellation_audit_request_.name: subscription_cancellation_audit_request_check
subscription_cancellation_audit_request_.value: ("payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."origin" in ('EXTERNAL','SCHEDULE_COMPLETED') and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."requested_at" is null) or ("payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."origin" not in ('EXTERNAL','SCHEDULE_COMPLETED') and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."requested_at" is not null and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."requested_at" <= "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."recorded_at")

subscription_cancellation_audit_confirma.name: subscription_cancellation_audit_confirmation_check
subscription_cancellation_audit_confirma.value: ("payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."confirmed_at" is null and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."ended_status" is null) or ("payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."confirmed_at" is not null and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."ended_status" is not null and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."ended_status" in ('CANCELED','EXPIRED') and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."confirmed_at" >= "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."recorded_at")

subscription_cancellation_audit_observed.name: subscription_cancellation_audit_observed_check
subscription_cancellation_audit_observed.value: "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."origin" not in ('EXTERNAL','SCHEDULE_COMPLETED') or "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."confirmed_at" is not null

subscription_cancellation_audit_withdraw.name: subscription_cancellation_audit_withdrawal_check
subscription_cancellation_audit_withdraw.value: ("payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."withdrawn_at" is null and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."withdrawal_reason" is null) or ("payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."withdrawn_at" is not null and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."withdrawal_reason" is not null and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."origin" = 'NONPAYMENT' and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."confirmed_at" is null and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."withdrawal_reason" in ('RECOVERED','OPERATOR_REVIEW') and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."withdrawn_at" >= "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."recorded_at")

subscription_cancellation_audit_supersed.name: subscription_cancellation_audit_superseded_check
subscription_cancellation_audit_supersed.value: (("payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."superseded_by" is null and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."superseded_at" is null) or ("payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."superseded_by" is not null and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."superseded_at" is not null and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."superseded_by" <> "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."id" and "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."superseded_at" >= "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."recorded_at")) and ("payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."supersedes_id" is null or "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."supersedes_id" <> "payments"."subscription_cancellation_audit"."id")

subscription_operations_amount_check.name: subscription_operations_amount_check
subscription_operations_amount_check.value:
(
      ("payments"."subscription_operations"."kind" = 'RETRY' and "payments"."subscription_operations"."provider_payment_id" is not null and "payments"."subscription_operations"."amount_in_cents" is not null and "payments"."subscription_operations"."amount_in_cents" > 0)
    or ("payments"."subscription_operations"."kind" <> 'RETRY' and "payments"."subscription_operations"."provider_payment_id" is null and "payments"."subscription_operations"."amount_in_cents" is null)
  )

subscription_operations_retry_terms_chec.name: subscription_operations_retry_terms_check
subscription_operations_retry_terms_chec.value: ("payments"."subscription_operations"."kind" = 'RETRY' and "payments"."subscription_operations"."retry_terms" is not null and jsonb_typeof("payments"."subscription_operations"."retry_terms") = 'object') or ("payments"."subscription_operations"."kind" <> 'RETRY' and "payments"."subscription_operations"."retry_terms" is null)

subscription_operations_execution_check.name: subscription_operations_execution_check
subscription_operations_execution_check.value: ("payments"."subscription_operations"."execution_attempts" = 0 and "payments"."subscription_operations"."execution_id" is null) or ("payments"."subscription_operations"."execution_attempts" > 0 and "payments"."subscription_operations"."execution_id" is not null and "payments"."subscription_operations"."started_at" is not null)

subscription_recovery_admissions_result_.name: subscription_recovery_admissions_result_check
subscription_recovery_admissions_result_.value: ("payments"."subscription_recovery_admissions"."state" = 'PENDING' and "payments"."subscription_recovery_admissions"."reason" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_admissions"."case_id" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_admissions"."next_attempt_at" is not null) or ("payments"."subscription_recovery_admissions"."state" = 'ADMITTED' and "payments"."subscription_recovery_admissions"."reason" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_admissions"."case_id" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_admissions"."next_attempt_at" is null) or ("payments"."subscription_recovery_admissions"."state" in ('REVIEW','IGNORED') and "payments"."subscription_recovery_admissions"."reason" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_admissions"."case_id" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_admissions"."next_attempt_at" is null)

subscription_recovery_policy_check.name: subscription_recovery_policy_check
subscription_recovery_policy_check.value: "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy" ? 'version' and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy" ? 'windowDays' and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy" ? 'reminderDays' and jsonb_typeof("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy"->'version') = 'number' and jsonb_typeof("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy"->'windowDays') = 'number' and ("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy"->>'version')::integer > 0 and ("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy"->>'windowDays')::integer between 1 and 30 and jsonb_typeof("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy"->'reminderDays') = 'array'

subscription_recovery_notice_check.name: subscription_recovery_notice_check
subscription_recovery_notice_check.value:
(
    ("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."initial_notice_id" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."initial_notice_accepted_at" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."deadline_at" is null)
    or ("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."initial_notice_id" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."initial_notice_accepted_at" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."deadline_at" is not null
      and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."initial_notice_accepted_at" >= "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."opened_at"
      and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."deadline_at" = "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."initial_notice_accepted_at" + (("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy"->>'windowDays')::integer * interval '86400 seconds'))
  )

subscription_recovery_notices_attempt_ch.name: subscription_recovery_notices_attempt_check
subscription_recovery_notices_attempt_ch.value: "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."attempt_count" >= 0 and (("payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."attempt_count" = 0 and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."last_attempt_at" is null) or ("payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."attempt_count" > 0 and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."last_attempt_at" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."last_attempt_at" >= "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."created_at"))

subscription_recovery_notices_receipt_ch.name: subscription_recovery_notices_receipt_check
subscription_recovery_notices_receipt_ch.value: ("payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."message_id" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."message_status" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."accepted_at" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."delivered_at" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."observed_at" is null) or ("payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."message_id" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."message_status" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."accepted_at" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."observed_at" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."accepted_at" >= "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."created_at" and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."observed_at" >= "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."accepted_at" and ("payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."delivered_at" is null or "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."delivered_at" between "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."accepted_at" and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."observed_at"))

subscription_recovery_notices_delivery_c.name: subscription_recovery_notices_delivery_check
subscription_recovery_notices_delivery_c.value: "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."message_status" is null or "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."message_status" not in ('DELIVERED', 'READ') or "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."delivered_at" is not null

recovery_resolution_dates_check.name: recovery_resolution_dates_check
recovery_resolution_dates_check.value: "payments"."subscription_recovery_resolutions"."original_charge_created_at" < "payments"."subscription_recovery_resolutions"."charge_created_at" and "payments"."subscription_recovery_resolutions"."charge_created_at" <= "payments"."subscription_recovery_resolutions"."observed_at" and "payments"."subscription_recovery_resolutions"."period_starts_at" <= "payments"."subscription_recovery_resolutions"."observed_at" and "payments"."subscription_recovery_resolutions"."period_starts_at" < "payments"."subscription_recovery_resolutions"."period_ends_at" and "payments"."subscription_recovery_resolutions"."observed_at" <= "payments"."subscription_recovery_resolutions"."resolved_at" and "payments"."subscription_recovery_resolutions"."resolved_at" <= "payments"."subscription_recovery_resolutions"."observed_at" + interval '60 seconds'

subscriptions_reconcile_idx.name: subscriptions_reconcile_idx
subscriptions_reconcile_idx.where: status = 'ACTIVE' AND provider_subscription_id IS NOT NULL
